title: feat(spec, metadata-protocol): Seed.fallback marks the set an organization gets when its locale matches no set of the object
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_ Closes #34940 Ruling: seat 3, route A (claim comment 6963214228 on the card): an explicit optional per-set marker `fallback: true` on a seed set, loaded only when no set of the same object matches the resolved locale; additive and opt-in, with conditions (1) at most one fallback set per object, (2) enforced at boot and at install/reseed/heal/replay with the liveness ledger recording the key live, (3) the seed docs and the skills seed page name it. Seat rulings on this PR's open questions (2026-11-18T01:25Z): - **Q1 = B.** The `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` hunk is dropped from this PR. A `domain:skills` child card, filed by triage, carries the seeds.md field rows and the eval case. Commit `e020dc236a` restores seeds.md to its `origin/main` bytes; history is not rewritten. - **Q2.** The load-time refusal of two fallback sets for one object is enough: no authoring-time check and no claim amendment. The strict reading that `fallback` needs `locale` stands. Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: added Skills-docs: follow-up #35070 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:种子数据集新增可选标记 `fallback: true`。按语言拆分的种子(如 zh-CN 与 en 两套标准价格表),标记其中一套后,语言不在任何一套之列的组织(ja-JP、es-ES)也能拿到这一套,而不是一条都没有。 - 为什么改:之前这类组织拿不到任何一套功能性种子(例如报价依赖的标准价格表),工单 #34940。 - 风险与回滚:纯增量;不写 `fallback` 的数据集行为逐字节不变(每条路径都有不带标记的对照用例)。同一对象两套都标记会拒绝整次加载、不写任何行。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`(`filterByLocale` 的回退分支与 `findDuplicateFallbackSets`);`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`(新键与 `dependentRequired` 规则)。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/seed-loader-locale-scope.test.ts`,预期 31 个用例全过,其中 `Seed.fallback fills in…` 一组 15 个。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。本 PR 已不触及受管面(技能页的两行改由 domain:skills 子卡承载)。 ## What changes - **Spec** (`SeedSchema`): new optional key `fallback: true` (the one value is `true`). `fallback` without `locale` is refused at parse, at the `fallback` key, through `dependentRequired({ fallback: ['locale'] })` from the closed projection list, so the published JSON Schema carries the rule (`dependentRequired: { fallback: ['locale'] }`) and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` does not grow. `locale` docs now point at the marker. - **Loader** (`SeedLoaderService`, the one funnel every seeding path goes through): `filterByLocale` keeps a marked dataset the resolved locale would drop when no locale-scoped dataset of its object lists that locale, and logs each such fallback at info. Two marked datasets of one object among the env-kept datasets of a load refuse the whole load before the landed-key record is opened, one error per object (`field: 'fallback'`), returned the way the `dependsOn` refusal is. A load with no locale is unchanged: every dataset loads and the existing warning names the marked one too. - **Liveness ledger**: `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json` gains a `live` `fallback` row (evidence, producer, pins); `state-counts/seed.md` regenerated (19 → 20). - **Generated**: `authorable-surface/data.json` (+`data/Seed:fallback`), and the reference pages `gen:docs` rewrites (`references/data/seed.mdx`, `seed-loader.mdx`, and the two that embed the seed table: `api/package-api.mdx`, `kernel/manifest.mdx`). - **Docs**: `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` gets an "A Fallback Set" section, a `defineSeed` signature line and a best-practice pointer. The skills seed page is not touched here (Q1 = B above). Decisions taken (the ruling asked for these to be decided and documented): - **`fallback: true` with no `locale` is refused, not read as redundant** (the stricter option). An unscoped dataset already loads for every locale, so the marker could only promise a behaviour the loader does not have, which is the declared-not-enforced shape ADR-0049 forbids. - **A fallback set lists locales: it must.** It loads for its own locales like any set, and also for unmatched ones. - **"Matches" means a locale-scoped dataset of the same object lists the resolved locale.** A dataset with no `locale` is locale-neutral: it loads beside the chosen set and does not block the fallback. Under the literal reading (an unscoped set "matches" every locale), any object carrying shared rows could never fall back. - **Judged after `env`.** A set `env` scoped out neither matches nor falls back. Two marked sets in different environments are not refused. - **The duplicate refusal is judged whatever the locale**, because the declaration is ambiguous on every load. Waiting for an unmatched locale would surface it on the first organization in a new market. ## Tests On head `6e739dfc35`. The code is unchanged since then: `e020dc236a` only restores seeds.md to main's bytes. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 851 passed (851), Tests 27250 passed, 1 todo. New in `src/data/seed.test.ts`, `fallback locale set` (5 cases): accepted with `locale` (full parse), absent by default, refused without `locale` (`code` custom, path `['fallback']`, first sentence), only `true` accepted, `defineSeed` carries and refuses it. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 352 passed, 9 skipped (361); Tests 23141 passed, 45 skipped. New in `src/seed-loader-locale-scope.test.ts`, 15 cases on rows reaching the engine: ja-JP gets the fallback, with an unmarked control giving none; another set matching blocks it, case-insensitive; own locales; unscoped set locale-neutral; per object; info line; no-locale load; env composition both ways; duplicate refusal (nothing written, error shape, any locale, one per object fine, split by env fine). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/app-plugin.seed-locale-producer.test.ts src/app-plugin.test.ts`: 72 passed. New top-level describe `Seed.fallback on the boot and install paths` (11 cases): inline boot seed (ja-JP app, plus an unmarked control and a zh-CN control), dev hot reload (marked and unmarked), per-organization replay (an organization setting of ja-JP with an unmarked control, a founder language of es-ES), and the install, reseed and heal request shape `runInlineSeed` builds (`resolveSeedLocaleForLoad`, then `SeedLoaderRequestSchema.parse`, then `load`), plus a duplicate refusal and a parse refusal at `seeds[0].fallback`. - Typecheck: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exited 0.
Ablation (one-time, not kept): the fallback branch neutralised The fix was committed first. Mutation made with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor `else if (isFallbackDataset(dataset) && !matched.has(dataset.object)) {` was hit once (1 to 0) and the guard was prefixed with `(globalThis as any).__ABLATED_34940__ &&` (0 to 1). Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build`, and `ablation-dist-preflight` reported the marker present in 2 built files. - `seed-loader-locale-scope.test.ts`: 7 failed, 24 passed (31). Every positive fallback case failed in the inert direction; the refusal cases stayed green, as they test a different branch. - `app-plugin.seed-locale-producer.test.ts`: 7 failed, 26 passed (33): inline boot, hot reload, replay with org setting, replay with founder, install, reseed, heal. - Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- `, hash equal to the HEAD blob, rebuild, `--absent` preflight reported the marker absent from all 24 built files and the tree clean. Re-run: 33/33 and 31/31.
## Acceptance notes - **Not governed**: after the seeds.md revert, `check-governed-merges --branch` reads 0 of 14 paths on the register — NOT governed. `check-skills-token-ratchet` stays green against main's seeds.md (1747 / 1747). - **One fallback per object is a loader refusal, not a stack-level schema refinement.** A refinement over `data: SeedSchema[]` would live in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, which is outside this claim's file surface, and it would not see stored `seed` items, which reach the loader without a stack. Stack-level authoring-time detection (`os validate`) is a possible follow-up. - Generated reference pages `api/package-api.mdx` and `kernel/manifest.mdx` changed because they embed the seed table. That is `gen:docs` output, which `check:docs` requires. - `#34791` shares `seed-loader.ts`, `seed.zod.ts`, `seed.test.ts` and the seed docs; `overlap-check` reads that it merges cleanly. ## Verification
Local gates on the final head e020dc236a: dispatch-gates.mjs --commands derived 116 families; 115 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED - Derived on `e020dc236a`, the seeds.md revert. Each command's exit code was captured before any pipe and recorded as `:: exit N`. - `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 116 derived, 115 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (derived from a recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN. - **NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** Reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because this fresh worktree has only the runtime and client-react closures built and the gate reads every published package's `dist/`. The same gate exited 0 on `6e739dfc35`, whose build output is byte-identical to this head's, since the only change is a markdown file under `skills/`. CI runs it. - The 8 families that dropped out of the derivation with the skills path (`check-skills-token-ratchet` and its self-test, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-links`) all exited 0 on `6e739dfc35`. `check-skills-token-ratchet` also exits 0 on this head: seeds.md is 1747 / 1747. - Earlier reds, fixed before this run: `check:test-source-alias` (a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` in the runtime test), and `check:skill-examples`, which had refused with PREREQUISITE NOT MET until the closure was built. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 14 artifacts current, and `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: 0, both on `6e739dfc35`.
Full CI (`Test Core`, dogfood shards and the rest of the farm) is left to the PR's check-runs. Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, `(widening)` arm). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzi6WQ71HhZSLSvHhdF
